desc: The SA Shotgun Tact is an efficient and reliable no-nonsense 12GA shotgun operating with an inertia style action and features a lightweight aluminum receiver with a 4 + 1 capacity. Comes with light weight polymer furniture and 18.5” vent rib barrel reamed for full. Modified and improved choke tubes making this a sporting shotgun that can approach any game situation. Chambered for both 2 ¾” and 4”shotshells.
